acceptanceCriteria: A refusal caused by an attempt names attemptId, holder, holderStatus and the recovery command
ticket show includes the ticket's current attempt summary
Decision recorded and tested on whether an expired-lease attempt blocks complete-manual
body: Observed 2026-10-21 (corvint-tasks local build from origin/main). complete-manual on V1-0127 returned REFUSED ATTEMPT_LIVE. queue status shows the blocker is attempt c37430781a59139cb59b584554bfbb4f, holder orchestrator, holderStatus LEASE_EXPIRED since 2026-10-21T11:16:55Z, phase BUILT (V1-0305 has the same state). ticket show returns no attempt details, so the closer had to search queue status to find it, and releasing it requires the holder's generation. Expected: an expired-lease attempt does not block a manual disposition, or the refusal names the attempt, generation and the recovery command (reap/release).

title: complete-manual is refused ATTEMPT_LIVE by an attempt whose lease expired hours ago, and ticket show does not name the blocking attempt
